## Figure 1: Map of nesting locations

```{r map}
getwd()
setwd("/Users/eliza/Desktop/FINAL 2025/mapping ")

# ---- Load packages ----

library(rworldmap)
library(sp)
library(sf)
library(cartography)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggdensity)
library(ggforce)

# ---- Load nesting locations ----

nesting.locations <- read.csv("locations_individual.csv", header = TRUE)

# ---- Basemaps ----

canada_basemap <- map_data("world") %>%
  filter(region == "Canada")

mexico_basemap <- map_data("world") %>%
  filter(region == "Mexico")

# Shapefiles for boundaries, USA/Canada, Mexican states, and lakes
BOW <- st_read("BOW_lines.shp")
BOW <- BOW %>% filter(adm0_a3 %in% c("CAN", "USA"))
usa <- st_read("usa_canada.shp")
mexico_states <- st_read("mexico_states.shp")
lakes <- st_read("North_America_Major_Lakes.shp")

# ---- Build the map ----

map <- ggplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  # Background layers for Canada and Mexico
  geom_polygon(data = canada_basemap, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey90", color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_polygon(data = mexico_basemap, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey90", color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  # Background layer for USA, with lakes on top
  geom_sf(data = usa, fill = "grey90", color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes, fill = "white", color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  # Boundary lines (USA/Canada, then Mexican states)
  geom_sf(data = BOW, color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = mexico_states, color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  # Nesting locations as points
  geom_point(data = nesting.locations,
             aes(
               x = Longitude,
               y = Latitude,
               fill = Ecosystem_condensed
             ),
             size = 2,
             shape = 21,
             stroke = 1,
             color = "black") +
  # Axis labels
  xlab("Longitude") +
  ylab("Latitude") +
  # Theme tweaks
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  # Plain numeric labels on the y axis (latitude), without "degrees N"
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  # Plain numeric labels on the x axis (longitude)
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  # Map coordinate system and extent
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-165.5, -60), ylim = c(27.5, 71), expand = FALSE)

map

ggsave("map_final2.pdf", plot = map, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
```

## Violin plot by sex

```{r sex-violin}
getwd()

library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
library(ggeffects)

final <- read.csv("full.csv")

# Violin plot with jittered points
sex <- ggplot(final, aes(x = Sex, y = Est)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Remove major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # Remove minor grid lines
    panel.background = element_blank()   # Remove panel background
  ) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, color = "coral4", shape = 16, size = 3,
              fill = "white") +
  ylab("95% AKDE Home Range Size (km^2)")
sex

# Violin plot with sina points, colored by sex
sex <- ggplot(final, aes(x = Sex, y = Est)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_sina(
    aes(color = Sex),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("95% AKDE Home Range Size (km^2)")

sex

ggsave("sex_final3.pdf", plot = sex, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

nrow(final)
```

## Basic stats

```{r basic-stats}
# Number of birds
length(unique(final$name))

table(final$name)

list(unique(final$name))

# Days used
median(final$Days_used)
mean(final$Days_used)
range(final$Days_used)

# Number of points
median(final$Points)
mean(final$Points)
range(final$Points)

# Mean home range size by ecoregion
mean(final$Est[final$Ecosystem_condensed == "Open"], na.rm = TRUE)
mean(final$Est[final$Ecosystem_condensed == "Taiga"], na.rm = TRUE)
mean(final$Est[final$Ecosystem_condensed == "Forest"], na.rm = TRUE)

mean(final_forested$Est)

# Home range size for all birds
mean(final$Est)
sd(final$Est)
range(final$Est)

# Home range size for males
mean(final$Est[final$Sex == "M"], na.rm = TRUE)
sd(final$Est[final$Sex == "M"], na.rm = TRUE)
range(final$Est[final$Sex == "M"], na.rm = TRUE)
sum(!is.na(final$Est[final$Sex == "M"]))

# Home range size for females
mean(final$Est[final$Sex == "F"], na.rm = TRUE)
sd(final$Est[final$Sex == "F"], na.rm = TRUE)
range(final$Est[final$Sex == "F"], na.rm = TRUE)
sum(!is.na(final$Est[final$Sex == "F"]))

# Histograms of home range size
hist(final$Est[final$Sex == "F"], main = "Home Range Size for Females",
     xlab = "95% AKDE Home Range (square kilometers)")

hist(final$Est, main = "Nesting Home Range Size in Red-tailed Hawks",
     xlab = "95% AKDE Home Range (square kilometers)")

table(final$Est[final$Sex == "F"])

new_final <- read.csv("table1.csv")
```

## Ecoregion plots

```{r ecoregion-plots}
final <- read.csv("final_all.csv")

library(ggplot2)

# Ecoregion effect estimates
results <- data.frame(
  Covariate   = c("Intercept (Boreal)", "Open", "Northern Boreal"),
  Mean        = c(0.30, -0.71, 0.55),
  Lower_95_CI = c(-0.14, -1.26, 0.03),
  Upper_95_CI = c(0.72, -0.14, 1.07)
)

# Violin plot by ecoregion
getwd()

pdf("ecoregions_violin1.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)

ggplot(final, aes(x = Ecosystem_condensed, y = Est)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_sina(
    aes(color = Sex),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15)
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("95% AKDE Home Range Size (km^2)")

dev.off()

ecoregions
```
